caption: The drawing depicts a single carved wooden figure centered on a plain, light background. The figure is painted and features a long, conical body with a reddish-brown color, simulating a robe, with some areas showing lighter patches as if the paint has faded or worn away. The figure's arms are defined and positioned in front, with hands pressed together in a gesture of prayer. The arms and the edges of the robe have dark outlines. The head is proportionally small and painted in lighter tones, with facial features including a long dark beard and mustache, dark eyebrows, and a solemn expression. The hair is dark and closely frames the face and extends down the sides and back of the head. The collar at the neck is dark, and there is a scalloped line at the base of the neck, possibly representing a decorative element of the garment. The background is unadorned, with a textured off-white surface.
title: Bulto
